job.command:
stardev
# Flatten sim_to_jet/ into the job's working dir (StRoot/ and # .sl73_x8664_gcc485/ stay as-is -- the build system expects those paths). cp sim_to_jet/* . cp shared/* . cp underlying_event/* .
if ( "{{GENERATOR}}" == "pythia8" ) then ln -sf starsim_pythia8_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia8" set tune_arg = ",{{PP_TUNE}}" else ln -sf starsim_pythia6_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia6" set tune_arg = ",{{FMS_TUNE}}" endif
set seed_temp=`od -vAn -N4 -tu4 < /dev/urandom` set myseed=`expr ${seed_temp} % 100000` set run_number = ${JOBINDEX}
# ptHatMin/ptHatMax for this job (see header comment) {{PTCUT_BLOCK}}
echo "========================================" echo "Generator = {{GENERATOR}} (tune/PDF param={{TUNE_PARAM}})" echo "FMS tune = {{FMS_TUNE}}" echo "ptHatMin = ${ptcut} GeV" echo "ptHatMax = ${ptcutmax} GeV" echo "FcsJetFilter Ethr = {{FILTER_ETHR}} GeV" echo "FcsJetFilter cone pT = {{FILTER_CONEPT}} GeV (0 = off)" echo "EM-only = {{EM_ONLY}}" echo "Use points = {{USE_POINTS}}" echo "Calib sample = {{CALIB_SAMPLE}}" echo "nevents = {{NEVENTS}}" echo "Save SimpleTree = {{SAVE_SIMPLETREE}}" echo "JOBINDEX = ${JOBINDEX}" echo "Random seed = ${myseed}" echo "========================================"
mkdir -p {{OUTDIR}}
echo "Starting detector simulation..."
setenv FCS_FILTER_CONEPT {{FILTER_CONEPT}} root4star -q -b starsim.C\({{NEVENTS}},${myseed},${ptcut},{{TUNE_PARAM}},{{FILTER_ETHR}},${ptcutmax}${tune_arg}\)
echo "Finished detector simulation."
# Keep the StarGenStats file (cross section, read by readMudst.C): # runSimBfc.C's output would overwrite this name mv ${pid}.starsim.root ${pid}.genstats.root
echo "" echo "Starting reconstruction..."
# CINT cannot skip arguments, so all are given to reach CALIB_RUN root4star -b -q runSimBfc.C\({{NEVENTS}},1,\"${pid}\",202207,0,0,1.5,0.0,\"0.0100\",0,0,input_dir,output_dir,input_chain,0,{{CALIB_RUN}}\) root4star -b -q readMudst.C\(0,1,\"${pid}.MuDst.root\",\".\",\"\",202209,${ptcut},${ptcutmax},\"{{TRIGGER_FILTER}}\"\)
echo "Finished reconstruction."
# Jet finding: JetMatcher takes a list-file arg, so write a one-line list. module purge module load fastjet-3.3.4 module load root-5.34.38
echo "Compiling JetMatcher..." g++ -m64 JetMatcher.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o JetMatcher \ `root-config --cflags --libs` -lEG \ `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11
set TRIGGER_FILTER = "{{TRIGGER_FILTER}}"
echo "SimpleTree_mudst.root" > single_file.list
if ( {{CALIB_SAMPLE}} == 1 ) then set jet_pt_cuts = 0 set ue_args = "0 minbias" else set jet_pt_cuts = 1 set ue_args = "" endif
./JetMatcher single_file.list "${TRIGGER_FILTER}" {{EM_ONLY}} {{USE_POINTS}} ${jet_pt_cuts} mv jet_output.root jet_output_{{GENERATOR}}_{{TUNE_PARAM}}_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root
# In-job underlying event (reco_ue_* branches), with this job's own # events as proxies; must run before the SimpleTree is renamed echo "Compiling UnderlyingEvent..." g++ -m64 -O2 UnderlyingEvent.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o UnderlyingEvent \ `root-config --cflags --libs` -std=c++11 echo "jet_output_{{GENERATOR}}_{{TUNE_PARAM}}_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root SimpleTree_mudst.root" > ue_pairs.list ./UnderlyingEvent ue_pairs.list ${ue_args}
set keep_simpletree = 0 if ( {{SAVE_SIMPLETREE}} > 0 ) then @ keep_simpletree = ( ${JOBINDEX} % {{SAVE_SIMPLETREE}} == 0 ) endif if ( ${keep_simpletree} == 1 ) then mv SimpleTree_mudst.root SimpleTree_{{GENERATOR}}_{{TUNE_PARAM}}_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root else rm -f SimpleTree_mudst.root endif
rm -f single_file.list ue_pairs.list ${pid}.genstats.root
echo "Files in scratch:" ls -l
